item.title: Wartime Emergency Center Operating in Kfar Chabad
item.description: In light of the war against Iran and the emergency mobilization of over 100,000 soldiers—including hundreds of Chabad Hasidim—the "Ezer L'Chayil" organization has successfully established a dedicated Emergency Command Center within just 24 hours to provide immediate aid to security forces and reservist families. Full Story

item.title: New Torah Magazine for Purim from Pittsburgh Zal
item.description: Pittsburgh Zal is proud to present the third issue of our Torah Magazine, created by one of our talmidim, Shmuly Lakher, in honor of Purim! Full Story

item.title: Megillah in Bomb Shelters as Iranian Missiles Fly Overhead
item.description: With Iranian missiles attacking Israel and large gatherings banned, dozens of smaller Megillah readings spread across communal bomb shelters, apartment buildings, and safe rooms. Full Story

item.title: Megillah Readings Around Crown Heights
item.description: Megillah readings for men, women, and children will take place all around Crown Heights, including every hour on the hour at some locations. Full Story

item.title: 700 Shluchim Built a Megillah App in 10 Days
item.description: Less than two weeks before Purim, Rabbi Mendy Elishevitz Shliach in Karmiel, IL dropped a link into the AI for Shluchim WhatsApp group, nearly 700 Shluchim who swap AI tips and experiments daily. The link: megillah.app. Full Story

item.title: NYPD Providing Extra Security in Crown Heights on Purim
item.description: As the festive holiday of Purim gets underway, the NYPD is significantly increasing its presence in the Crown Heights neighborhood in light of ongoing events in the Middle East. Full Story

item.title: Live: Community Purim Bash With Eli Marcus
item.description: A festive Purim party will take place in Crown Heights, with l’chaims, music and dancing and lavish Dairy Buffet at Bais Rivkah on Lefferts Avenue. Live

item.title: Live: 30 Letters in 30 Days
item.description: Live at 10:00 PM ET: Rabbi Shais Taub re-launches his annual “Thirty Letters in Thirty Days” live series, beginning Motzei Shabbos at 10 PM ET, as a 30-day preparation for the Rebbe’s birthday featuring nightly classes on letters from Volume 12 of Igros Kodesh. Live

item.title: Stranded Israel Travelers Land in Athens in Time for Purim
item.description: The Chabad shluchim from Athens stepped up to help 125 young people on Israel volunteer trips celebrate Purim. Full Story

item.title: Hundreds Fill 770 for Megillah on Purim Night
item.description: Colorful costumes were in sight at the main Shul of 770 Eastern Parkway as hundreds gathered Monday night to hear the Megillah. Photos, Video
